title: The pretraining domain outweighs the training objective in setting the privacy-utility trade-off of differentially private medical image analysis
abstract: arXiv:2601.19618v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Differential privacy limits how much each training image can influence a medical imaging model but lowers its diagnostic accuracy. Pretrained weights reduce this loss. It is unknown whether the pretraining objective or domain improves accuracy more. Here we train chest radiograph classifiers under differential privacy from five starting points on 591,884 radiographs from five datasets. We show that supervised pretraining on chest radiographs ranks first in 24 of 25 combinations of dataset and privacy setting. Measured by the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve, its lead over supervised pretraining on natural images is 2.6% without privacy and 15.3% at the strictest budget. From that starting point, changing the domain improves this area 2.2 to 3.7 times more than changing the objective. Private pretraining on chest radiographs lowers this area by about 5% under privacy but outperforms the three starting point

translated_title: 预训练领域在决定差分隐私医学图像分析的隐私-效用权衡时比训练目标更为重要
translated_abstract: 差分隐私限制了每张训练图像对医学成像模型的影响程度，但会降低其诊断准确性。预训练权重可以减少这种损失。然而，目前尚不清楚预训练目标还是预训练领域能更大程度地提高准确性。在本研究中，我们从五个不同的起点出发，使用来自五个数据集的591,884张胸片，在差分隐私条件下训练胸片分类器。结果表明，在25种数据集与隐私设置的组合中，有24种组合下，在胸片上进行监督预训练的表现排名第一。以受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUC）衡量，与在自然图像上进行监督预训练相比，其领先优势在无隐私保护时为2.6%，在最严格的隐私预算下为15.3%。从该起点出发，改变预训练领域比改变预训练目标对该指标的改善效果高出2.2至3.7倍。在胸片上进行隐私保护的预训练会使该指标在隐私保护下降低约5%，但仍优于其他三个起点。
tldr: 在差分隐私医学图像分析中，预训练数据领域（胸片还是自然图像）比预训练目标对隐私-效用权衡的影响更大，其中在胸片上进行监督预训练能取得最佳效果，在最严格隐私预算下AUC领先自然图像预训练15.3%。
en_tdlr: In differentially private medical image analysis, the pretraining domain outweighs the pretraining objective in setting the privacy-utility trade-off, with supervised pretraining on chest radiographs achieving the best performance, leading by 15.3% AUC over natural image pretraining under the strictest privacy budget.
